sourceTitle: Banana Bread made with Xocai Healthy Chocolate
sourceText:
Banana Bread made with Xocai Healthy Chocolate
By: Xocai Chocolate
Published: Thursday, November 8, 2012 - 10:48am

Ingredients




2 cups whole wheat flour (100% Whole Wheat Flour)
1 tsp baking soda
1/4 tsp salt
1/4 cup butter
3/4 cup brown sugar
2 whole eggs (beaten)
2 1/3 cups mashed banana
1 oz dark chocolate (Xocai Activ Powder)
3 chunks dark chocolate (Xocai X Power Squares, chopped)
2 chunks dark chocolate (Xocai Omega Squares, chopped)

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease 9x5-inch loaf pan. In large bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt. In a separate bowl, cream butter and brown sugar. Stir in eggs and mashed bananas until well blended. Stir in Activ, X Power and Omega Squares. Stir banana mixture into flour mixture; stir just to moisten. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven for 60 to 65 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into center of the loaf comes out clean. Let bread cool in pan for 10 minutes; turn out onto wire rack. Serves 4

About

Xoçai is the worlds creator of truly HEALTHY Chocolate! You may be wondering if chocolate can really be healthy. The answer is an overwhelming “YES!” In fact, thousands of studies have shown that high-quality, antioxidant-rich chocolate can contribute to major health improvements. People across the globe have discovered that Xoçai Healthy Chocolate truly can make a difference in one’s health. Learn more here: www.xocai.com
